project_type: Go backend + React/Vite/TypeScript frontend, assisted teaching app
build_system: go build for backend, npm for frontend, docker-compose for integration
test_framework: go test with httptest mock servers (backend), vitest (frontend)
verification_instructions: 1. Run go test ./... in backend/ 2. Verify no compilation errors 3. Check that hermes_test.go covers file write scenario
setup_instructions: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v18.20.8/bin:$PATH" for node; Go 1.25.1 already available
contribution_requirements: Feature branches, PR workflow, conventional commits (feat:, fix:), do NOT merge or release
key_patterns: HermesBridge receives hermesURL+apiKey, PiBridge receives workDir. Pi emits file_changed events after agent_end. safePath in files.go validates paths. tools.ts normalizes tool payloads with name/path/status. Frontend Chat.tsx already handles file_changed events from tool type StreamEvents.
directory_structure: backend/ - Go backend (main.go at root, internal/bridge/ for WS bridges, internal/api/ for REST handlers); frontend/src/ - React app (components/, hooks/, i18n/); workspace/ - course files
